definition.factor_transform: percent_rank ascending within each month cross-section

research_run.lookahead_method: factor ranks are computed per month; return uses the following monthly adjusted close; eligible score factors mom1 and mom3 only
research_run.cost_calibration: 0.002 return fraction per 1.0 portfolio turnover inferred from stored gross_return/net_return records

limitations: The 925-symbol dataset is survivor-oriented; historical point-in-time index/listing membership has not been validated.
Known delisted-symbol price histories are missing from the inspected dataset; survivorship bias can materially inflate or distort results.
The 2024-09 to 2025-08 window is a retrospective diagnostic, not a clean prospective out-of-sample because research and candidate search occur after those dates.
The 2025-09 to 2026-08 window is explicitly post-hoc and must not be used as a virgin holdout or to claim validation.
Train contains 33 usable monthly observations; it is not the full 35-month intended training window.
The field maxdd60 is NULL for all 52,485 rows in the current monthly factor table and must not be used in candidate scoring.
The formula is a research candidate only and must not be routed to real-money execution.
promotion_gates: Reconstruct and verify point-in-time SET/mai membership with official source artifacts, SHA-256 manifest, delisted securities, IPO dates, and non-overlapping membership intervals.
Rebuild prices including delisted names and reconcile adjusted-price/action handling.
Run independent transaction-cost/slippage sensitivity at 20, 30, and 40 basis points per turnover unit.
Freeze definition and data snapshot before a prospective paper-only validation window.
Require reproducible run ID, dataset fingerprint, formula hash, monthly return series, benchmark alignment, and CI integrity checks before any promotion.
